verdict.rationale: Mastercard's Open Finance APIs support the core operations (link via Connect, balances, transactions, account ownership) and there is an official MCP surface (agent-toolkit) documented for developer Q&A and code generation, but the MCP overview is framed as a docs/code-gen assistant for AI tools like Claude/Cursor, not as an agentic interface for actually creating link sessions, retrieving live balances/transactions, or managing connections with scoped credentials at runtime. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server exposes actual banking operations (create link session, get balance, list transactions, manage connections) rather than just documentation/code-sample retrieval, and evidence of scoped/limited credentials for agent use versus full partner API keys.
